OOD A1 attention score source atlas

closest_prior_work.relation: Changed only the subject-source score across PP/relative contexts; it did not split all source-score changes in fronted OOD syntax.
Established that the fronted final-subject value recovers 127.71% versus 53.85% by number direction and that all earlier values are causal-mask no-ops; it did not intervene on source scores.

novelty: First exact causal split of the fronted OOD L11H3 score contribution. First run the whole-score-vector by final-subject-value 2x2. Then, with the donor subject value fixed, cross recipient/donor scores for three preregistered semantic groups: fronted phrase positions 0-6, subject determiner position 7, and final subject/self position 8. Include all eight group corners and each source-score singleton under both native and donor subject values. Outcomes are answer margin and CE.

registered_screens.earlier_score_sufficiency: in the weak singular-recipient to plural-donor cell under the donor subject value, changing fronted-phrase plus subject-determiner scores recovers at least 70 percent of the all-score conditional correction, using a ratio of cell-mean marginals, with at least 75 percent donor direction and positive CE contribution
registered_screens.self_score_sufficiency: independently, in that cell under the donor subject value, changing only the final subject/self score recovers at least 70 percent of the all-score conditional correction, using a ratio of cell-mean marginals, with at least 75 percent donor direction and positive CE contribution; both sufficiency screens may pass under redundancy
registered_screens.directional_score_need_reproduction: complete-minus-value-only is positive and at least 30 percent of complete-head margin in the weak cell; this is a required reproduction of the parent atlas, not new evidence

required_controls: native capability and complete-head donor direction in both A1 direction cells
exact factor replay and source-term sum
value-only arm reproduces OOD atlas v2
all donor scores plus the only changed donor value reproduce the complete donor head row by row
all pre-subject donor and recipient projected values are equal row by row
whole-score by final-value 2x2, eight semantic score-group corners under donor value, and every source-score singleton under both value states are evaluated in one batched intervention forward
the whole-score 2x2 closes exactly as total effect equals score main effect plus value main effect plus their interaction

interpretation_limits: This is an OOD-text-reuse within-family characterization, not pristine OOD confirmation.
The 30 percent score-need condition is already implied by the opened parent result and is only a liveness/reproduction gate.
Singleton source-score effects and their value interactions are descriptive because downstream effects need not add; the preregistered semantic-group factorial carries the causal interpretation.
The final self-score changes both query and key state; this experiment does not identify the separate Q, Q2, K, or K2 branch.
